title: Ruleset: calendar
description: rules/<id>/calendar.yaml: what a new day does to the story's variables (apps/session: CalendarAdapter; game/story: new_day.hpp).

day_counters.description: Story variables that grow by one each day, unless they hold stopped_value.

stopped_value.description: The value that stops a day counter, and leaves a daily mark's variable alone.

daily_marks.description: Story variables whose bits each day clears.
